title: Webkernel Package Schema v1
description: Schema for extra.webkernel in composer.json — Webkernel lifecycle plugin.

$schema.description: Reference to the schema file. Can be a local path or a remote URL.

provider.description: FQCN of the Webkernel ServiceProvider for this package.

module.description: Parent module reference (vendor/name) for feature packages.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle hooks, environment checks, and concern-based code generation for this package.

checks.description: Environment checks run at post-autoload-dump time. Each check is a PHP expression; truthy = problem.

check.description: PHP expression. Evaluated with eval(). Truthy return = check failed.

message.description: Human-readable failure message shown in Composer output.

fix.description: Optional shell command hint displayed to the developer to fix the issue.

events.description: Map of Composer script event names to FQCN or Class::method callables.

concerns.description: Ordered list of concern FQCNs to run during post-autoload-dump. Each concern owns exactly one code-generation responsibility.

items.description: FQCN of a class implementing LifecycleConcernContract.

x-monorepo.description: Monorepo configuration (development only, ignored in production).

package-repos.description: List of git remote URLs for managed sub-packages.
